notes.notes: [p]Hey all! notes.title: Retrowave '84 - July 2025 development update!
notes.notes: [p]Hey all, first of all some great news!! The hardest technical hurdle for moving Retrowave '84 forward has been resolved! So I'm gonna aim to get the game finally released this year as things stand! The demo of course will be updated around the time nearer release with all other fixes/optimisation, but things are now about getting that final 10% of the game done and ready! Thanks for the continued support as always, and nearer the time, will have it's final release date revealed (hopefully as soon as the coming months)! Take care all in the meantime![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810370/63fd12d8a915b0b82a7b56c1285ca8d4cbca51a8.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: RETROWAVE '84 JUNE 2025 DEVELOPMENT NEWS/UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hey all, so far many of the technical hurdles remaining have been resolved, as well as new features/improvements have been added such as a much more flexible FOV slider, as well as a speed run time option for those who are up for challenges such as that! Both will be featured in the final demo version along with the full release! Work after this month will involve getting the game deck verified! As always, thanks for continued support and following, and will see you all next month, as always, the public community discord is always open, as well as frequent updates on both X/Twitter as well as my YouTube channel! Take cares!

PS: Here's a handy link to my YT channel! https://www.youtube.com/@GameDevKS

notes.title: Monthly Devlog Update: May 2025
notes.notes:
First and foremost, since bringing on additional help, the game looks on course to hopefully release this year! A lot of the final technical issues have been related to the engine version, but with the additional technical support, these issues will be sorted (it's also a major factor that's linked to the demo not launching for many)! Of course, as stated many times before, the game release date wont be revealed until I've submitted the final build to valve and they have confirmed it to be ready to do (so when that date drops, it's there and then)! I also have one last Voice actor reveal so keep an eye out for that. I want to say a big thanks though to many who've kept following this game and wishlisting! With the game being approximately 90 percent done, It's been a roller coaster for me for some time, but will be something really cool when it drops! Thanks as always for the support, till the next month, take care!

PS: Here's a cool bike drift that you'll be able to pull off in the game...

Secondly, regarding the game itself, progress content wise is coming along nicely, and will be continued to be refined and polished along the way!
